column2: In the handoff fire script, where is the function defined that checks whether an account is usable by running a one-turn headless model call before firing? Give the line of the function definition.
Which file and line define the list of model ids for which Claude Code's own native read-before-write refusal still holds (so the repo's own shim stays out)?
In the PreToolUse hook that consults a model to decide permission prompts, where is the internal deadline in seconds for that consult defined?
In the token ledger tool, where is the cache-read price multiplier defined that applies to any model without its own entry?
In the model-reference lint script, on which line are stale model literals collected from the versions keys whose names end in _prior?
In the model-bump sweep tool, on which line does the loop over the model families (frontier, opus, sonnet, haiku) begin?
Where is the default list of fallback model aliases set in the tool that recovers a pane blocked on a model safeguard?
In the research-kit router, where is the function defined that returns the model used for the careful classifier kind?
In the headless precondition probe script, which line sets the default per-run timeout in seconds?
Where is the shared shell helper function defined that spawns a child process in its own session so it survives the calling tool's process-group kill? Give the line of the function definition.
Which bats test asserts that a write by a model inside the binary's natively enforced set is allowed, because the native guard still refuses? Give the line of that @test.
In the multi-account quota tool claude-accounts, on which line is the module-level log file path assigned?
In claude-accounts, where is the usage percentage threshold defined at or above which the tool makes a one-token messages call to read the rate-limit headers?
In the research-kit router, on which line is the claude executable located on PATH for the classifier call?
In the limit-recover recon canary rig, where is the path to the kitty kitten binary set?
In the token ledger, where is the function defined that normalizes a model id by stripping a [1m] suffix and a date suffix?
